keyPoints: Dhatuen (metals) aam taur par chamkili, majboot, taar-khinchne yogya (ductile) aur peetkar patra banane yogya (malleable) hoti hain.
Dhatuen ushma aur vidhyut ki achhi suchalak hoti hain — isi liye bijli ke taar taambe ke bante hain aur bartan aluminium-lohe ke hote hain.
Adhatuen (non-metals) aam taur par bhungur hoti hain aur ushma-vidhyut ki kharab suchalak hoti hain, jaise gandhak, koyla, lakdi aur oxygen.
Loha, taamba, aluminium, sona aur chandi dhatu hain; oxygen, carbon, gandhak aur nitrogen adhatu hain — dono ke gun aapas me ulte hain.
Kuch tatva dono ke gun dikhate hain, jaise silicon aur germanium — ise updhaatu (metalloid) kehte hain, jo electronic yantraon me kaam aate hain.
Dhatuon ko khuli hawa-paani me chhodne par jang lagta hai; rang-rogan ya tel lagakar inhe surakshit rakha ja sakta hai.
Aam galti: dhatuen hamesha thos hoti hain ye manna; paara (mercury) kamre ke taap par drav dhatu hai aur sodium itna naram hai ki chaku se kat jaata hai.
